freeKit.name: The S/4HANA Readiness Starter Kit
freeKit.blurb: Try the toolkit format before you buy. A free, structured set of prompts to begin assessing your readiness for the move from ECC to S/4HANA — and to see exactly what a Tavren toolkit gives you.

series.name: Finance Director Series
series.blurb: Structured toolkits that help finance teams carry readiness, reporting and testing work in-house — work that would otherwise sit on a consultancy invoice.

packs.name: Pack 1 — Finance Readiness Kit
packs.blurb: Assess where finance stands before the upgrade — surface gaps, dependencies and decisions early, while there is still time to act on them.

packs.name: Pack 2 — Universal Journal Reporting
packs.blurb: Prepare your reporting for the Universal Journal — map what changes, what to test, and what your team needs to know to keep month-end clean.

packs.name: Pack 3 — Business Testing Pack
packs.blurb: Build business-led test scenarios and acceptance criteria that prove finance processes work — before go-live, not after.

packs.name: Pack 4 — Data Cleanse & Master Data
packs.blurb: Find and fix the master-data problems that derail migrations — duplicates, gaps and inconsistencies — before they become go-live issues.

packs.name: Pack 5 — Cutover & Go-Live Comms
packs.blurb: Plan a calm, well-communicated cutover — checklists, stakeholder comms and the questions to settle before the switch.

series.name: Sales Director Series
series.blurb: Toolkits that give sales and commercial teams a structured path through readiness, data, order-to-cash and go-live — without leaning on external billable hours.

packs.name: Pack 1 — Readiness Kit
packs.blurb: Take stock of where the sales function stands before the upgrade, and surface the risks and decisions that need owning now.

packs.name: Pack 2 — Customer & Pricing Data
packs.blurb: Get customer and pricing data clean and consistent — the foundation for accurate quoting and billing after the move.

packs.name: Pack 3 — Order to Cash
packs.blurb: Map and pressure-test the order-to-cash process end to end, so revenue keeps flowing through the transition.

packs.name: Pack 4 — Business Testing
packs.blurb: Define business-led test cases that prove your sales processes hold up — written by the people who run them.

packs.name: Pack 5 — Cutover & Go-Live
packs.blurb: Run a controlled cutover for the commercial function — the checks, comms and contingencies that keep customers unaffected.

series.name: Supply Chain Series
series.blurb: Toolkits for procurement and supply-chain leaders — readiness, sourcing, risk and spend analysis structured so your own team can do the heavy lifting.

packs.name: Pack 1 — Supply Chain Readiness Assessment Kit
packs.blurb: Assess supply-chain readiness for the upgrade and surface the process, data and capability gaps to close first.

packs.name: Pack 2 — Strategic Sourcing & Supplier Evaluation Kit
packs.blurb: Structure sourcing decisions and supplier evaluations with a repeatable, defensible method your team can run again and again.

packs.name: Pack 3 — Negotiation & Contract Readiness Kit
packs.blurb: Prepare for supplier negotiations and contract reviews — the positions, questions and terms to settle before you sit down.

packs.name: Pack 4 — Supply Chain Risk & Resilience Kit
packs.blurb: Map supply-chain risk and build resilience into the plan — spot single points of failure before they find you.

packs.name: Pack 5 — Spend Analysis & Cost Optimisation Kit
packs.blurb: Analyse spend and find cost-optimisation opportunities with a structured approach that stands up to scrutiny.

series.name: HR Director Series
series.blurb: Toolkits for HR and people leaders — workforce readiness, change, organisation design and retention, structured to keep adoption and capability on track through the upgrade.

packs.name: Pack 1 — Workforce & Organisation Readiness Assessment Kit
packs.blurb: Assess how ready your people and organisation are for the change, and where to focus effort first.

packs.name: Pack 2 — Change Management & Adoption Kit
packs.blurb: Plan change and adoption properly — the communications, training and engagement that make new ways of working stick.

packs.name: Pack 3 — Organisation Design & Operating Model Kit
packs.blurb: Work through organisation design and operating-model questions with structure, so roles and accountabilities are clear post-upgrade.

packs.name: Pack 4 — Skills, Capability & Workforce Planning Kit
packs.blurb: Plan the skills and capability your team will need, and close the gaps before they slow the programme down.

packs.name: Pack 5 — Talent Retention & Employee Experience Kit
packs.blurb: Protect retention and employee experience through a period of change, when good people are most at risk of walking.
